note: Which palaces and concepts a life domain gathers, for the report-wide ledger (src/interpret/reason/ledger.ts). A system convention (he_thong), labelled as such: the usual practice of reading a matter through its own palace, the palace's tam phương tứ chính and the palaces the books tie to it. Where a book sentence ties palaces together it is cited in `cite`. The ledger adjudicates each domain once (book link → specificity → tier → two-ways, the order of reason/adjudicate.ts); it never sums scores. Roles: core = the palace of the matter; tam_hop / xung = its tam phương tứ chính; support = a palace the convention adds.

verdicts.thuan: the readings point one way and nothing in the core palace limits them
verdicts.co_dieu_kien: one side is the base, the other (or a limiting element of the core palace) sets its conditions — or a timing reading ties both sides to different times
verdicts.hai_chieu: both sides rest on seats of the same weight and nothing ties them: told as two sides
verdicts.tro_ngai: the limiting side is the base; what helps only softens it
